title: Marx and Ackerman — dedication and lapse
shortTitle: Marx and Ackerman — dedication and lapse
summary: The notes compare long delays in accepting public land dedications.
notes: Marx treats sixty-eight years as too long and also discusses withdrawal; Ackerman accepted a twenty-eight-year delay. The fact that a dedication is ordinarily continuing does not make every time period reasonable. Revocation requires an act, whereas lapse can result from the passage of time. The note asks which act counted as revocation rather than supplying a general numeric limit.
